name: Nackte Furry Camping Con
description: Nackte Super Furry Weekend (NSFW), previously known as Nackte Furry Camping Con (NFCC), is an annual 18+, clothing-optional furry camping convention held at Camp Nackte in Stockdale, Texas. It offers activities common to furry conventions, such as a pool party, dealers' den and swap meet, a drag show, a night DJ rave, lumberjack games and a fire spinning show, along with adult-oriented panels. Attendees receive a written code of conduct, which is also reviewed aloud each morning.
